title: Notice on New Trading Pairs & Trading Bots Services on Binance Spot - 2023-12-21
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for the BLZ/FDUSD, RARE/TRY and VANRY/TRY spot trading pairs at  2023-12-21 08:00 (UTC) . In addition, Binance will enable Trading Bots services for the following trading pairs at  2023-12-21 08:00 (UTC) .  Spot Grid, Spot DCA & Rebalancing Bot: 1000SATS/USDT, BONK/USDT Start Trading on Binance Spot Now!  Notes: TRY is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. Users will enjoy zero maker fees on  FDUSD  trading pairs until further notice. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2023-12-20
